title: Binance Adds Pixels (PIXEL) on Earn, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Pixels (PIXEL)  has been added to  Binance Simple Earn  and  Binance Convert . In addition, Binance will add  PIXEL  on  Binance Margin ,  Binance Futures  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at  2024-02-19 15:00 (UTC), 2024-02-19 15:00 (UTC)  and  2024-02-21 00:00 (UTC)  respectively.  Earn Users can now subscribe to  PIXEL Flexible Products  on Binance Simple Earn. From  2024-02-21 at 00:00 (UTC) , users may purchase PIXEL using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Convert Users can now trade PIXEL against BTC, USDT and any other tokens supported by  Binance Convert  at  zero fees .  Margin Binance Margin will add  PIXEL  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  PIXEL/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-02-19 15:00 (UTC) . Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M PIXEL Perpetual Contract  at  2024-02-19 15:00 (UTC) ,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M PIXEL Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract  PIXELUSDT Launch Time  2024-02-19 15:00 (UTC)  Underlying Asset Pixels (PIXEL)  Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.0001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the PIXELUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2024-02-19 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-02-19 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-02-20 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-02-20 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Qualified USDⓢ-margined futures liquidity providers will be eligible to enjoy  0.005% maker fee rebates  for trades on the PIXELUSDT Perpetual Contract for approximately 14 to 15 days. Refer to  this announcement  for more information. Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the PIXELUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the PIXELUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the PIXELUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The PIXELUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
